sourceContext: Costa Clean App ChatGPT Project - bounded repair of the four factual test failures certified by CC-CMD-0002
objective: Diagnose and minimally correct the four test failures factually observed by CC-CMD-0002 on canonical baseline 368ed1f75ecda0c0f383c6df4ccffee216db76ce, then recertify the repository locally without changing product behavior or performing remote product mutations.
why: CC-CMD-0002 completed correctly and established that dependencies, lint, typecheck, and build pass, while exactly four tests fail: two ENOENT failures caused by temporary directories under .project-agent/private not existing, and two 5000ms timeouts around verifyPackageManifestV6(). The failures must be repaired narrowly and from evidence rather than by weakening tests.
scope: Start from exact canonical baseline 368ed1f75ecda0c0f383c6df4ccffee216db76ce in a fresh isolated execution worktree for CC-CMD-0003.
Reproduce the four failures observed by CC-CMD-0002 before modifying code.
Diagnose and minimally fix the two ENOENT failures involving temporary paths under .project-agent/private.
Measure the execution cost of verifyPackageManifestV6() and identify the actual bottleneck behind the two 5000ms test timeouts before changing timeout budgets.

Optimize redundant or avoidable local verification work when supported by timing evidence; use a narrowly scoped explicit per-test timeout increase only if the remaining cost is legitimate, deterministic, and cannot reasonably be reduced.

Limit edits to the test/operations/client-portal verification code directly required by these four failures, primarily scripts/ops/run-project-continuation-agent.mjs, scripts/ops/run-project-continuation-agent.test.mjs, scripts/ops/projectContinuationAgentCore.test.mjs, scripts/client-portal/run-cp3b2a-qa-v6.mjs, scripts/client-portal/cp3b2aV6RealAdapter.test.mjs, and scripts/client-portal/cp3b2aQaApplicationV6.test.mjs; a directly invoked helper under scripts/client-portal may be changed only when measured evidence proves it is the bottleneck and the reason is recorded.
Run the four previously failing tests first after repair, then run the full configured test suite, lint, typecheck, and build.
Produce factual evidence describing root cause, files changed, targeted verification, full verification, and any residual failures.
Publish only the factual CommandExecutionResult for CC-CMD-0003 to orchestrator/control; leave all Costa Clean remote branches and production systems unchanged.
outOfScope: Changing business logic, UI behavior, CRM behavior, database behavior, billing, authentication, or product features.
Weakening assertions, skipping the four tests, marking them flaky, deleting them, or globally disabling timeout enforcement.
Increasing a timeout before measuring verifyPackageManifestV6() and documenting why the increase is necessary.
Broad refactors unrelated to the four observed failures.
Changing Supabase migrations, remote database state, QA database state, production data, secrets, or environment credentials.
GitHub main changes, pull requests, merges, tags, releases, or publication of Costa Clean application code.
Vercel deployment or any production mutation.
Reusing CC-CMD-0001 or CC-CMD-0002 runs/worktrees as the execution run for this command.
acceptanceCriteria: A new run dedicated to CC-CMD-0003 is created and bound immutably to baseline 368ed1f75ecda0c0f383c6df4ccffee216db76ce.
The original four failing tests are reproduced or, if environment timing prevents exact reproduction, their prior CC-CMD-0002 evidence is preserved and the discrepancy is explained before edits.
Both ENOENT failures are eliminated by establishing the required private temporary-directory precondition without weakening publication safety or secret isolation.
The two verifyPackageManifestV6() timeout failures have measured timing evidence identifying where time is spent.
Any timeout increase is per-test or equivalently narrow, justified by measured evidence, and not used to hide a hang or unnecessary repeated work.
The four previously failing tests pass after the scoped repair.
The full configured test suite passes, or any remaining failure is reported truthfully with exact evidence and is not repaired outside scope.
Lint, typecheck, and build pass or are reported truthfully with exact evidence.
No product/business behavior is changed and no files outside the justified repair scope are modified without a recorded evidence-based reason.
No Costa Clean remote application branch, Supabase, Vercel, production, secret, billing, DNS, email, or payment state is mutated.
A factual CC-CMD-0003 result is published to orchestrator/control using the canonical result publication contract.
stopConditions: Project identity, Brain hash, command hash, accepted baseline, or execution worktree binding mismatch.
The runtime attempts to select CC-CMD-0001, CC-CMD-0002, or any run other than the new CC-CMD-0003 run.
The execution worktree does not start at exact baseline 368ed1f75ecda0c0f383c6df4ccffee216db76ce.
The proposed repair requires business/product behavior changes rather than test-harness or verification-code corrections.
A timeout increase is proposed without timing evidence or would be global rather than narrowly scoped.
Any test is skipped, weakened, deleted, or converted into a non-asserting check to obtain PASS.
An unexpected file outside the justified repair scope must be modified.
Any mutation is required on GitHub application branches, Supabase, Vercel, production, secrets, DNS, billing, email, or payments.
The human Costa Clean checkout changes unexpectedly.
Side-effect state becomes ambiguous or unreconciled.
verificationRequirements: Verify project identity, accepted Brain binding, and canonical baseline before any repair work.
Capture exact pre-repair reproduction commands and outputs for the four target failures.
For each ENOENT failure, record the missing parent path, the caller responsible for creating the temporary directory, and the minimal precondition fix.

Measure verifyPackageManifestV6() wall time and, where practical, major internal steps such as manifest loading, expected artifact identity computation, and working-tree identity verification before deciding on timeout changes.
Run the four target tests after repair and capture exact exit codes and durations.
Run the full configured test suite, lint, typecheck, and build and preserve exact commands, exit codes, durations, and sanitized outputs.
Record all changed files and explain why each changed file is necessary for one of the four failures.
Verify no business/product source behavior was changed.
Verify no unauthorized remote or production mutation occurred.
Bind all factual evidence to projectId, commandId, new runId, Brain version/hash, baseline, and execution worktree.
